examples.name: Sample — a cell cut by the page break
paragraphs: A two-row table whose second Brief Description cell ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page — as these services are also — with the rest on the next page. The row, not just the table, is split. Each page's fragment keeps only that page's visible text.

rows.text: Brief Description of Program and Recommended Reduction or Increase

The Budget restructures OCWS to concentrate its work on the systems that serve the most residents. Over the last decade, the Office has taken on a growing portfolio of small, overlapping grants that are costly to administer and difficult to evaluate. An internal review found that many awards were made without clear performance targets, and that a number of grantees could not show how funds had been used. The Budget proposes to consolidate these grants into three focus areas: drinking-water treatment upgrades, stormwater and flood resilience, and lead service line replacement. Each focus area would carry measurable outcomes and a public progress report. The Budget also ends funding for the Estuary Demonstration Program (-$212 million), which has not produced results that could be applied elsewhere, the Harbor Monitoring Pilot (-$88 million), the Regional Water Planning Councils (-$140 million), and the Small Systems Outreach Network (-$176 million). Technical assistance now delivered through these programs would be offered through the three focus areas instead, so that communities apply once rather than several times. The Budget maintains $9 billion for capital grants to water and wastewater utilities.
Regional Library and Archive Grants (RLAG) Eliminations

The Budget proposes to wind down RLAG, which funds local library and archive projects through a competitive process. Many of the funded activities, such as digitizing local records and extending opening hours, are already supported by county and municipal budgets. The Budget eliminates the Community Reading Rooms Program, the Local History Preservation Program, and the Mobile Library Services Program.
